en: Lance
{player}. Good, you found the way down. This place is a maze of corridors and locked doors.
Your Pokémon have been working hard. Let me see to them before we go any further.
{player}'s Pokémon were restored to full health!
Lance
Team Rocket's grunts are everywhere down here. I'll scout ahead. Be careful, {player}.
Lance
Rest when you need to. Team Rocket won't give you the chance once a battle starts.
The Electrode in the generator room are powering the signal. Stop them, and the signal stops with them.
Dragonite: Grroar!
Lance
Wait, {player}. Not that way. The generator comes first: the Electrode are on the west side of the room.
Murkrow
Krah! The boss is back! The boss is back! Krah!
The Murkrow keeps repeating the same words. That must be the password to the shutters!
The Murkrow flew off down the corridor!
The shutter is locked tight. A speaker beside it crackles: 'Password?'
A speaker beside the shutter crackles: 'Password?' {player} said what the Murkrow kept repeating.
The shutter slid open!
Hold it right there! Where do you think you're going?
Ariana
So you're the child who's been running about my hideout. Did you really think I'd let that go?
This is where your little adventure ends.
Lance
Not while I'm here. {player}, let's take them on together!
Ariana
Hmph. Fine. We'll leave this hideout. We have plans that matter far more than this one.
And there's nothing you can do to stop them.
Lance
They've run. That leaves the signal. It comes from the generator in the room behind those shutters.
Its power comes from Electrode wired into the machine. Help me stop them, {player}.
A huge machine thrums and crackles. Cables run from it to the Electrode around the room.
The machine is silent. Not a spark comes from it now.
An Electrode wired into the generator! It's glaring at you!
An Electrode wired into the generator! It's glaring at you!
An Electrode wired into the generator! It's glaring at you!
The generator shuddered and went quiet.
Lance
That's the last of them. The signal has stopped. The lake's Magikarp will calm down now.
Team Rocket has scattered, too. With their hideout gone, Mahogany Town can breathe again.
You've done well, {player}. I'll make sure the League hears about this. Until we meet again!
